detected_fault: Severe technical issues with integrated Intel UHD graphics card being used instead of NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060
suggested_solution: Disable iGPU or use MUX switch to force the game to use the NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060.
Try changing from window borderless to full screen and vice versa to see if it resolves the issue.
Disable GPU hardware acceleration in Windows to rule out any potential conflicts.
